test_cases.title: 7d and 90d requests on seeded multi-window data return different totals (differential-range, usage_events source)
test_cases.given: a program_id seeded with usage_events distributed across a 7-day window and a separate window only reachable at 90 days (i.e. some events older than 7 days but within 90 days)
test_cases.when: GET .../commands?range=7d and GET .../commands?range=90d are both called for the same program_id
test_cases.then: the two responses have different total_runs values, proving the aggregation reads usage_events (per-event ts) and not the lifetime-only program_commands table
test_cases.objective: Catch the C-4/R-6 defect class where ?range= becomes a silent no-op because the handler reads program_commands (lifetime, unranged) instead of usage_events. This is the single highest-value test in the story: a suite asserting only 200+non-empty passes even when range filtering is completely broken.
preconditions: Authenticated session bearer token available

Seeded program_id=prog-multi-window with usage_events: N events with ts within the last 7 days, plus M additional events with ts between 8 and 90 days ago, N != 0 and M != 0, across at least one shared command name
No reliance on the program_commands rollup table for this fixture — assertion must fail if the implementation reads that table instead
steps: Send GET /api/overview/program-detail/prog-multi-window/commands?range=7d with a valid bearer token; capture total_runs_7d and items_7d
Send GET /api/overview/program-detail/prog-multi-window/commands?range=90d with a valid bearer token; capture total_runs_90d and items_90d
Assert total_runs_7d != total_runs_90d (explicit comparative assertion, not independent 200 checks)
Assert at least one command's count differs between items_7d and items_90d, or a command present in items_90d is absent from items_7d
expected_results: total_runs_7d is strictly less than total_runs_90d given the seeded fixture (90d window is a superset of the 7d window's activity plus the older events)
The comparison is explicit (assert-not-equal on the two totals), not merely two independent '200 + non-empty' checks
Response counts trace to usage_events timestamps, not program_commands lifetime rollup values

test_cases.objective: Verify barStyle uses the max-of-range formula per ADR-0009 / PGD-04-FR-3, distinguishing it from a share-of-total calculation that would produce different values.
preconditions: Authenticated session bearer token available

test_cases.title: Program-level command totals are computed independently from personal-usage commands panel
test_cases.given: a signed-in user whose personal usage differs from the program's aggregate usage (other users also ran commands on the program)
test_cases.when: the program commands endpoint and the personal-usage commands panel are both queried for the same range
test_cases.then: the two totals differ (or independently match by coincidence) but neither is derived from or equal to the other by construction — the program total includes all users' events, the personal total only the caller's
test_cases.objective: Verify program-level and personal-level command aggregations query independently and are not coupled or derived from each other.
preconditions: Authenticated session bearer token available for user-A
Seeded program_id=prog-shared with usage_events from user-A and user-B, where user-A's own command counts are a strict subset of the program total
steps: Send GET /api/overview/program-detail/prog-shared/commands?range=30d as user-A; capture program_total_runs
Send GET /api/personal-usage/user-A?range=30d as user-A; capture personal commands total
expected_results: program_total_runs reflects all users' events on prog-shared (>= personal total, since user-B also contributed)
personal commands total reflects only user-A's own events
The two totals are not equal (given the seeded fixture) and no shared computation path derives one from the other

notes: E2E: N/A for this story per docs/stories/PGD-04.md Test mapping and REQUIREMENTS.md Scope — PGD-04 ships backend-only; no frontend component (CommandsActivity.tsx) exists or is scoped to render this panel. All TCs are integration/contract/performance at the API layer.

Security NFR (RBAC open-aggregate, 401 gate) is covered via AC-4 (PGD-04-TC-10) and AC-5 (PGD-04-TC-09) rather than a separate PGD-04-NFR-security id, since the story's Non-functional requirements section states security as 'never UI-only hiding' with no independent numeric/security budget beyond what those ACs already assert; no PGD-04-NFR-security TC was fabricated to avoid an orphan id not declared in the PRD.
Accessibility NFR is explicitly N/A per REQUIREMENTS.md ('no new UI ships') and is intentionally omitted from this manifest.
PGD-04-TC-05 is the highest-priority test per research R-6/C-4: it is the only test in this suite that fails if the implementation reads program_commands (lifetime rollup) instead of usage_events.
